meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 装上后会先把旧版 NanoClaw 与 Claude 的记忆搬进共用的 memory/ 目录,并把角色与行为设定写进 instructions.prepend.md。它负责暂存、整理、建索引、核对旧文件,最后交出每份文件的源到目标报告。
howto.when: 更新提示 shared-memory 破坏性变更后运行,或某分组仍留着 .seed.md、旧 CLAUDE.md、Claude 自动记忆等遗留文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我把旧记忆迁移到共享记忆树
say.note: 先列出受影响分组,等你批准再动手

say.text: 分组 X 还留着旧 CLAUDE.md,迁移它
say.note: 会把旧文件暂存后逐份整理归档

say.text: 切换后 agent 什么都不记得了,查一下旧记忆
say.note: 会检查 .seed.md、自动记忆等来源

howto.what_en: Moves legacy NanoClaw and Claude memory into the shared memory/ tree and writes standing instructions into instructions.prepend.md. It stages, organizes, indexes and verifies old files, then reports every source-to-destination move.
howto.when_en: Runs after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md, Claude auto-memory, etc.

say_en.text: Migrate my legacy memory into the shared memory tree
say_en.note: Lists affected groups before moving anything

say_en.text: Group X still has a legacy CLAUDE.md, migrate it
say_en.note: Stages then organizes those old files

say_en.text: The agent forgot everything after the switch, check its old memory
